Software Development Engineer, Catalog System Services - SPCL

Job ID: 10539357 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now
Description

As a Software Development Engineer II in the SPCL (Selling Partner Close Looping) team, you will design and build innovative solutions that enhance how millions of customers discover and shop for related products across Amazon's global marketplaces. Working with billions of product variation relationships (sizes, colors, styles), you'll leverage cloud computing, machine learning, and Large Language Models to ensure variation data quality and consistency. Your work will directly impact customer shopping experiences, making it easier for them to navigate between product variants and find the right version of a product that meets their needs.

Key job responsibilities
* Design and develop scalable services that measure, validate, and improve variation relationship quality across billions of products
* Implement sophisticated algorithms to ensure consistency in variation theme attributes (size, color, style) across all global marketplaces
* Build innovative GenAI solutions using Large Language Models to automatically evaluate and enhance variation quality
* Create robust feedback mechanisms that enable continuous improvement of variation data
* Develop tooling and APIs that help Selling Partners address product variation quality issues
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement solutions that enhance customer discovery experiences
* Participate in architectural decisions that balance performance, cost, and customer experience

A day in the life
* Write and review high-quality, well-tested code in languages such as Java and Python
* Collaborate with team members on design documents and architectural decisions
* Analyze data to identify variation quality issues and measure improvement impact
* Attend daily stand-ups and participate in sprint planning/retrospective meetings
* Work with product managers to scope and prioritize new features
* Debug and resolve production issues while maintaining service reliability
* Monitor system performance and optimize for scale and efficiency
* Stay current with latest ML/AI technologies and evaluate their potential application
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance

About the team
The SPCL team sits within Amazon's Catalog Systems division and is responsible for ensuring customers can easily navigate between related product options. We build systems at massive scale, processing billions of product relationships that power shopping experiences across all Amazon marketplaces. Our team maintains a high bar for operational and software engineering excellence while fostering a collaborative and supportive culture. We work closely with data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to continually improve the quality of variations in Amazon's catalog, directly enhancing the customer shopping journey.

Basic Qualifications

- 1+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
